description: Proportional-symbol map of South Australian dogs or cats recorded at home, 2025. Circle area shows council totals on one scale across species. Shared controls, linked council highlighting, pan, zoom and tooltips support exploration.

marks.name: councilSymbols

tooltip.signal: {'Council': datum.name, 'Pet type': speciesWord, 'Recorded at home': format(datum.animals, ',.0f'), 'Residents': format(datum.residents, ',.0f'), 'Recorded animals per 1,000 residents': format(datum.rate, '.1f')}

description.signal: datum.name + ': ' + format(datum.animals, ',.0f') + ' ' + lower(speciesWord) + ' recorded at home.'

usermeta.method: One circle per council at its projected geographic centroid. A zero-based linear scale, shared across dogs and cats, maps animal totals to area. Larger circles draw first. Shared map controls select species and camera; all 68 councils remain available.

scales.symbolArea: Map animal totals linearly to area, not radius. The domain includes both species, so twice the total produces twice the area across species as well as councils.

usermeta.codeGuide: Data lookup joins selected-species totals to boundaries. geoCentroid places symbols; symbolArea maps totals to area. Shared camera and focus signals connect both maps and the scatterplot. Focus changes outline and opacity without changing size.
